Name: Anti-Reset Mr. Reduggy
Author: Kevorama0205
Description:
[b]Anti-Reset Mr. Reduggy[/b] adds a new NPC with only one function: to judge you for resetting your day! If you close out of your game when you've already left your farmhouse, or load an old version of your save file, Mr. Reduggy will know and he will have something to say about it if you start the day again. He will be forgiving if you only reset once (we all bomb our crops on occasion, after all), or if you stopped playing for a bit, but expect a long rant if you keep resetting over and over. Maybe it will cause you to reconsider your perfectionism and accomplish more overall with your valuable time. 

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip the mod folders into Stardew Valley/Mods (both the content patch for the NPC and the mod)
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.﻿
[/list][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer (even if other players don't have it)
[*]Most mods; I can't imagine why one would fail to work with this one.
[/list]
[/list]
